patterns.message: Framework-agnostic boundary: files in src/engine, src/interactions, src/windows, src/menus and src/dev must not import Vue, Pinia, composables, or App.vue. Keep framework glue in src/composables/ and App.vue — and note Vue is on its way out entirely (docs/remove-vue-plan.md), so new UI belongs in plain TS. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
